lead_fa: Feral یک اسپک میله‌ای فرم‌عوض‌کن است که با ساختن و خرج کردن Combo Point و Energy بازی می‌کند و بیشتر آسیبش خونریزی (Bleed) است. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Wildstalker]] با Bloodseeker Vines و [[Druid of the Claw]] که Ferocious Bite را به Ravage تبدیل می‌کند؛ در پچ 12.1 هر دو تقریباً هم‌ترازند.

strengths: Strong AoE options in the talent tree
Strong, frequently usable cooldowns with a good spread of types
Decent off-healing; strong defensive options baseline and talented
Some of the best mobility of any spec in the game
Brings Mark of the Wild, a Druid-specific Versatility buff
weaknesses: Talent builds are highly specialized: single-target builds struggle in AoE and vice versa
Everything Feral offers is brought by another spec, leaving it reliant on tuning
Relatively fragile passively as a melee spec

druid_changes: Matted Fur absorb increased by 25%; Heart of the Wild empowered Wild Growth healing +25%; Shred and Cat Form Swipe damage +10%
feral_changes: All damage dealt increased by 3%; Rampant Ferocity damage +25%
Saber Jaws damage bonus increased to 60% per point (was 50%); Focused Frenzy reduced to 15% (was 20%)
Rip and Tear damage bonus increased to 20% (was 15%); Chomp damage +30%

hero.recommendation: The two trees are tuned nearly identically in 12.1; the main dividing factor is tuning, not gameplay. Druid of the Claw is the strongest in early gear; Wildstalker has stronger sustain.
hero.wildstalker: Focuses on Bloodseeker Vines, a procced Bleed that buffs damage dealt to a target.
hero.druid_of_the_claw: Buffs direct damage and converts Ferocious Bite into Ravage. Stronger defensive option (extra health, stronger Bear Form, Dreadful Wound) and the strongest throughput in early gear; bursty with some randomness.
hero.note: Both trees are very passive and do not significantly change rotation; DotC wins defense, Wildstalker wins sustain.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Feral Druid Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/druid/feral/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Maintain debuffs (Rake, Moonfire, Rip) and spend extra resources on direct damage.
Snapshotting matters: refresh Rake/Moonfire when it increases snapshot strength (Tiger's Fury window).
Sync Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury.

st_druid_of_the_claw: Ferocious Bite with Apex Predator's Craving procs
Rip with 5 Combo Points if missing/in Pandemic and Tiger's Fury is active (or will not be active before the DoT expires)
Ferocious Bite with 5 Combo Points and 50 energy when Rip is active (with or without Berserk)
Sync Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury
If Tiger's Fury comes off CD within 3s and you are above 80% energy, dump energy
Rake if missing/in pandemic, if it increases snapshot strength, or if 2s or less remain and Tiger's Fury is not ready
Moonfire if missing/in pandemic, if it increases snapshot strength, or if 2s or less remain and Tiger's Fury is not ready
aoe: Ferocious Bite with Apex Predator's Craving procs
Primal Wrath if Rip is missing or in pandemic
Ferocious Bite with 5 Combo Points, 50 energy and Rip active
Tiger's Fury on cooldown (up to 2s delay if Frantic Frenzy comes off CD just after TF ends)
Swipe during Berserk for Claw Rampage procs; Swipe with Clearcasting procs
Rake if missing/in pandemic up to 5 targets
opener: Ferocious Bite at 5 Combo Points and 50 energy; Shred to generate during Berserk
rotation.berserk_notes: Berserk: % damage increase plus a free Combo Point every 1.5s and generators generate an additional Combo Point; Combo Points above the 5 cap become a buffer buff that converts back when you return to 0. Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane replaces it for 20s with additional effects.

gear.gearing_rules: Mastery > Haste = Critical Strike > Versatility for both heroes; this priority outweighs Agility, though big ilvl upgrades still win. Sim with Raidbots. With the 12.1 catalyst changes, what you catalyze matters a lot; getting the tier set is the most important thing.

tier_set.name: Bark of the Enigmatic Dreamwatcher
tier_set.pc2: When Berserk ends, you deal 10% increased damage for 1 sec for each combo point spent during Berserk.
tier_set.note: Looks synergistic with Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane and Ashamane's Guidance but is specifically nerfed there (extension only 0.75s instead of the full second).

notes: Mastery > Haste = Crit > Versatility for both Wildstalker and Druid of the Claw.
The secondary priority can outweigh Agility, but large item level upgrades still tend to win.

gems.note: Use one of each colour; exact selection depends on your stats, so sim.

mplus.hero_note: Wildstalker carries the Best tags for Mythic+ and Delves currently; Druid of the Claw is fully viable and wins in early gear.
tips: AoE builds are highly specialized: swap builds for heavy AoE weeks.
Primal Wrath covers Rip application on packs; Rake up to 5 targets.
Mark of the Wild and off-healing (Rejuvenation) add real group value in keys.
